*** Free & Prefect***

FP Calculator is a calculator designed for iPhone and iPad that includes basic calculations, arithmetic equations, currency conversions, and unit conversion functions. Two interface styles, dark mode, and normal mode are available for you to choose from.

• Top Utilities Apps Worldwide
• Award-winning calculator app for iPad and iPhone

FEATURES:
• Stay Perfect & Keep Free 
• Dark and light background for your choice
• Split-screen computing support on the iPad side
• Powerful calculation functions
• 160 currencies to convert
• 10 unit conversions
• Automatically save history
• Bill Splitting - Check the fees
• Self-selection result decimal display
• Multiple button sounds
• High quality customized user services

- WE LOVE FEEDBACK -
If you encounter any usage problems, you can contact us via user feedback on the settings page or email: FPcalculator@gmail.com
We welcome your valuable comments!

If you like the app, please feel free to leave us a 5-star rating and review!

Make Apps Free & Perfect.
